title: EMS HMI Server Configuration
description: Configuration for the hmi_server module. Defines HTTP server port, operator authentication, and display settings for the React HMI touchscreen interface.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

server.description: HTTP server binding parameters. The HMI server runs a FastAPI backend serving the React frontend, REST API, and WebSocket streams over a single HTTP port (WebSocket is multiplexed via FastAPI on the same port).

http_port.description: HTTP port for serving the React HMI frontend, REST API, and WebSocket connections. Default: 8080. Must be above 1024 for non-root operation.

host.description: Network interface to bind the HMI server. '0.0.0.0' binds all interfaces (accessible from network); '127.0.0.1' restricts to localhost only.

auth.description: HMI user authentication settings. Two access levels: operator (read-only + basic commands) and admin (full configuration access). Pins are stored as bcrypt hashes — never store plain-text PINs.

operator_pin_hash.description: bcrypt hash of the operator PIN code. Operator role allows viewing all data and issuing start/stop commands. Generate with: python3 -c "import bcrypt; print(bcrypt.hashpw(b'1234', bcrypt.gensalt()).decode())". Never store the plain-text PIN.

admin_pin_hash.description: bcrypt hash of the admin PIN code. Admin role allows changing configuration, alarm thresholds, and schedules. Use a strong PIN (6+ digits). Generate same as operator_pin_hash.

session_timeout_s.description: Automatic session timeout in seconds. HMI will return to locked state after this period of inactivity. Range: 60s (1 min) to 7200s (2 hours). Typical: 1800s (30 min).

display.description: HMI display and refresh settings for the touchscreen interface.

refresh_interval_ms.description: Dashboard data refresh interval in milliseconds. Determines how frequently the HMI polls for updated telemetry. Shorter intervals improve responsiveness but increase CPU load.

kiosk_mode.description: Enable kiosk mode for dedicated touchscreen installations. When true, the browser runs fullscreen without navigation controls, preventing operator access to the underlying OS.

screen_size.description: Target screen size for UI layout optimization. Selects the appropriate CSS breakpoint and component sizing for the installed touchscreen.
